eligibility: Age 18 or older. ECOG 0-2 (or Karnofsky 60% or higher).

Histologically confirmed RCC with a clear cell component, with or without sarcomatoid features, after complete radical or partial nephrectomy. Microscopically positive soft tissue or vascular margins without gross residual disease allowed.

Risk group: intermediate-high (pT2 grade 4 or sarcomatoid N0M0, or pT3 any grade N0M0); high (pT4 N0M0, or any pT N+ M0); or M1 NED (solid, isolated soft-tissue metastases, not brain or bone, resected or treated with definitive radiation or ablation synchronously or within 1 year of nephrectomy).
Surgery (nephrectomy, metastasectomy, or ablation) more than 4 and no more than 16 weeks before registration, with no ongoing surgical complications.
No evidence of disease on CT or MRI of brain, chest, abdomen, and pelvis. No prior systemic therapy for RCC.

ANC at least 1,000/mm3, platelets at least 100,000/mm3, hemoglobin at least 8 g/dL, total bilirubin at most 1.5 x ULN, AST/ALT at most 3 x ULN, CrCl at least 30 mL/min, urine protein 1+ or less on UA or UPCR below 2 mg/mg.
Not pregnant and not nursing (pregnancy test within 14 days before registration).
HIV allowed on effective ART with undetectable viral load within 6 months. Chronic HBV allowed with undetectable viral load; HCV must be cured or have undetectable viral load on treatment.
Cardiac disease or prior cardiotoxic therapy: NYHA class IIB or better. No history of myocarditis or clinically significant pneumonitis.
No uncontrolled hypertension (above 150/90 on 2 readings at least 2 hours apart).
No grade 3 or higher GI, pulmonary, or GU bleeding within 1 month. No moderate or severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh B or C).
No active peptic ulcer disease, IBD, or other GI condition with perforation risk; no abdominal fistula, GI perforation, or intra-abdominal abscess within 4 weeks.
No serious non-healing wound, ulcer, or fracture within 28 days. No active infection requiring parenteral antibiotics. No allogeneic organ transplant.

No autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment in the past 2 years (replacement therapy, vitiligo, psoriasis, type 1 diabetes, stable hypothyroidism, Sjogren's allowed). No steroids above 10 mg/day prednisone equivalent within 14 days of starting treatment or other immunosuppressants within 30 days of randomization.
No chronic strong CYP3A4 inducers (stop 14 days before treatment). No hypersensitivity to study drugs.
Prior or concurrent malignancy allowed if it would not interfere with safety or efficacy assessment; no currently active second malignancy.

registry_schema.label: Design
registry_schema.text: Standard treatment for patients with early stage gastric cancer consists of perioperative chemotherapy and surgical resection. If radiation therapy is administered in the adjuvant setting, the radiated area is often large and associated with significant toxicity. In this study, the investigators propose the addition of short course radiation therapy (SCRT) to chemotherapy in the neoadjuvant setting. The investigators hypothesize that this regimen of Total Neoadjuvant Therapy (TNT) will result in a higher rate of complete response (both pathologic and clinical), with less toxicity.

registry_schema.text: The investigators will randomize patients presenting with early BCR with a negative baseline PSMA PET/CT, to upfront SRT or surveillance. Early BCR is defined as a PSA relapse of \>0.1 to \<0.3 ng/mL. Patients in the surveillance arm will be monitored with PSA every 3 months. registry_schema.text: About 4-10% of patients with nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) have metastatic disease at diagnosis. The treatment recommendation of primary metastatic NPC is systemic chemotherapy. However, the optimal regimen is yet to determine due to lack of prospective randomized trial for this unique group of patients. Generally, GP regimen is used as the first-line treatment of primary metastatic NPC. The aim of this study is to compare the efficacy of Toripalimab Combined with GP Regimen Chemotherapy Versus GP Regimen Chemotherapy for Primary Metastatic NPC.
